declarations.description:
A desktop-style menu bar: File, Edit, View… as a row of `c2-menubar-menu` children, each a trigger and the
`c2-menu` it opens. The bar is one Tab stop; the arrow keys move across it, and once a menu is open, hovering
another trigger or pressing ArrowLeft/ArrowRight inside the menu moves the open menu with it, the way an
application's menu bar does (WAI-ARIA menubar pattern).

Keyboard on a trigger: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight go to the previous/next menu (wrapping, mirrored right-to-left),
Home/End to the first/last, a letter to the next menu whose label starts with it; Enter, Space or ArrowDown open the
menu on its first row, ArrowUp on its last. Inside a menu, ArrowRight opens a submenu or, on a plain row, moves to
the next menu; ArrowLeft closes a submenu or, at the top level, moves to the previous menu; Escape closes the menu
and returns focus to its trigger.

The `start` and `end` slots hold what sits beside the menus (an app icon, a document title, a "Saved" status); they
are outside the `menubar` role. Activated rows fire `menu-select`, which bubbles from the row through the bar.
declarations.name: Menubar

declarations.description:
One menu of a `c2-menubar`: a trigger labelled `label` ("File", "Edit", …) and the rows it opens. The trigger is a
native button with the `menuitem` role, and the menu is a `c2-menu` anchored under it, so the rows are everything a
`c2-menu` takes: `c2-menu-item` children (checkbox and radio rows, shortcuts, descriptions, submenus), `<hr>`
separators and `<h1>`–`<h6>` group headings.

Keyboard and pointer movement across the bar belong to the `c2-menubar` around it; on its own the element behaves
like a menu button (Enter, Space or ArrowDown open on the first row, ArrowUp on the last, Escape closes).
declarations.name: MenubarMenu

cssProperties.name: --c2-menubar-menu__menu--offset

cssParts.description: The native button that opens the menu.
cssParts.name: trigger

slots.description: The rows: `c2-menu-item` elements, `<hr>` separators and `<h1>`–`<h6>` group headings.
slots.name: default

members.name: label
members.description: The trigger's text, which is also its accessible name.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the menu is showing. Set it to open or close the menu from code.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Leaves the trigger focusable and announced but never opens the menu; the bar's arrow keys skip it.

members.name: placement
members.description: Preferred placement of the menu (floating-ui names); it flips near the viewport edge.

members.name: menuLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the menu surface. Defaults to the trigger's name.

members.name: tabStop
members.description:
Whether the trigger is the bar's Tab stop. Every trigger starts as one, so the bar works before it has upgraded
(and under a server render); `c2-menubar` keeps a single one once it runs.

members.name: pendingFocus
members.description: Which row the menu should focus when it next opens. `open` set from code moves no focus; `show()` does.

members.name: triggerElement
members.description: The native button that opens the menu.

members.name: displayLabel
members.description: The trigger's text, for the bar's typeahead.

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the menu. `'trigger'` keeps focus on the trigger (a menu opened under the pointer), `'none'` leaves it where it is.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the trigger.

events.description: Bubbles from the activated row (from `c2-menu-item`, unchanged).
events.name: menu-select

events.description: The menu opened or closed; `newState` is `open` or `closed`.
events.name: toggle
